shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, low relief
repeated animals arranged in a horizontal row/register
schematic animal bodies with legs and head shown in side view
relief figures set against a plain undecorated ground
justification: Both surfaces show schematic quadrupeds carved in shallow relief, shown in profile and repeated in a horizontal sequence along the stone, with the same convention of a simple raised silhouette against a plain ground and no interior detail. The clearest difference is that B organises its animals into stacked registers combined with a geometric net/zigzag panel and a large lower animal, whereas A shows a looser scatter of profile creatures without any framing bands or geometric motifs.
